# Zoth Studio v2

> Zoth Studio v2 is a local-first, zero-egress multi-agent development studio engineered by Neal Frazier Tech (@1nc0gn30 • NullAI Platform). It unifies 85 free open-access developer, security, AEO, and AI tools, 45 Studio workstations, 21 Pantheon agents across 5 operational cadres, WebGPU WASM acceleration, and biomorphic Spike-Timing-Dependent Plasticity (STDP) synaptic memory designed to run on your own machine.

Canonical URL: https://zoth.nullai.tech
Codebase: https://github.com/NullAITech/zoth-studio-v2
Publisher: Neal Frazier Tech • NullAI Platform (https://nullai.tech)
npm CLI: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@nullaitech/zoth

## Quickstart (npm CLI)

- `npx @nullaitech/zoth status`: Check which local Zoth services are running.
- `npx @nullaitech/zoth list`: List the 84 public Zoth tool repos (of 85 free open-access tools in Zoth Studio).
- `npx @nullaitech/zoth pull <tool>`: Download a Zoth tool repo.
- `npx @nullaitech/zoth studio`: Install and launch Zoth Studio locally on http://localhost:3000.
- `zoth open ax-powerhouse --json`: Open or inspect the Zoth AX Powerhouse & Contract Studio route metadata.
- ZothOS v3.4.0 (Debian 13 KDE Plasma 6 Linux OS with 23 resident daemons & 85 tools): https://zothos.nullai.tech | https://github.com/NullAITech/zoth-os

## Core Hubs & Consoles

- [Sovereign Hub](https://zoth.nullai.tech/): Primary mission control, zero-egress architecture overview, and quickstart commands.
- [Zoth AX Powerhouse & Contract Studio](https://zoth.nullai.tech/workstations/ax-powerhouse): Live AX endpoint auditor, 6-spec machine contract validator, and downloadable AX bundle compiler.
- [Zoth GitHub Studio & Autonomous Repo Workstation](https://zoth.nullai.tech/workstations/github-tool): Hybrid dual-org (NullAITech + 1nc0gn30) repository fleet inspector over loopback :3000 (`/api/studio/github`, `/api/studio/github/audit`, zero token reads) paired with offline browser Conventional Commits release synthesis, GitHub Actions CI-gate linting, and SSH/GPG commit-signing playbooks.
- [Sovereign Operator IDE & Code Foundry](https://zoth.nullai.tech/workstations/ide): Hybrid zero-egress code workstation combining a multi-file browser editor, multi-language AST/symbol outline extractor, deterministic static security linter, LCS unified diff/patch generator, pure recursive-descent expression evaluator (zero `eval()`), and hardened read-only loopback :3000 host toolchain and `~/NullAITech/` file inspection (`/api/studio/ide`, `/api/studio/ide/inspect`).
- [Lucy Netrunner Memory Hub](https://zoth.nullai.tech/memory): Biomorphic STDP synaptic associative memory matrix, real-time waveform visualizer, and SQLite vector strata.
- [21 Swarm Pantheon](https://zoth.nullai.tech/swarm): Autonomous multi-agent coordination across Architects, Code, Security, Creative, and Swarm cadres.
- [Byzantine Consensus Arena](https://zoth.nullai.tech/consensus): Triadic AST diff arbitration and cryptographic 2/3 quorum verification.
- [Autonomous WebGen](https://zoth.nullai.tech/webgen): Deterministic zero-cloud website generator and layout synthesizer with 6 architectural archetypes.
- [HexStrike Cybersec Terminal](https://zoth.nullai.tech/hexstrike): Local CVE vulnerability matrix, attack surface analyzer, and exploit audit lab.
- [Zoth OS Kernel](https://zoth.nullai.tech/zoth-os): Local Linux KVM hypervisor sandbox, thin QEMU disk management, and WebContainer runtime.
- [Adytum Sanctum](https://zoth.nullai.tech/adytum): 22 Hermetic key engineering lifecycle, 5-minute incubation gates, and Argon2id hardware key vault.
- [Sovereign Arsenal](https://zoth.nullai.tech/arsenal): Comprehensive searchable directory of all 45 workstations, 85 Studio tools (44 in-browser/WebGPU + 41 local CLI/daemon, 84 public GitHub repos), and 21 autonomous Studio Pantheon agents.
- [Micro-Tools Registry](https://zoth.nullai.tech/tools): Schema-validated in-browser and local CLI developer utilities for JWT verification, payload entropy, AEO/AX auditing, and code export.
- [Workstations Matrix](https://zoth.nullai.tech/workstations): 45 interactive studio environments spanning Build, Security, Swarm, Spatial, and Observe bands.
- [Enclave Bridges](https://zoth.nullai.tech/bridges): End-to-end encrypted inter-agent signal mesh and local IPC bus monitor.

## Formal Mathematical Pillars

- [Six Mathematical Pillars Academy Workstation](https://zoth.nullai.tech/workstations/math-pillars): Interactive deterministic solver workbench for all six mathematical pillars plus Byzantine BFT Quorum bounds (`N >= 3f + 1`), live SVG curves, step-by-step derivations, SHA-256 verification receipts, and JSON/Markdown/CSV/LaTeX exports (`/api/studio/math-pillars`, `/api/studio/math-pillars/evaluate`).
- [Six Mathematical Pillars Theory Academy](https://zoth.nullai.tech/docs/math): Formal mathematical foundations governing attention, loss landscapes, dynamical systems, STDP, and BFT bounds.
- [Pillar I: Linear Algebra](https://zoth.nullai.tech/docs/math/linear): Attention mechanisms, projection tensors, and scaled dot-product matrices.
- [Pillar II: Multivariable Calculus](https://zoth.nullai.tech/docs/math/calculus): Non-convex gradient descent, AdamW momentum, and loss manifolds.
- [Pillar III: Probability & Information](https://zoth.nullai.tech/docs/math/probability): Shannon entropy, sampling temperature dynamics, and token logit distributions.
- [Pillar IV: Loss Landscapes & Hessian](https://zoth.nullai.tech/docs/math/hessian): Curvature eigenspaces, Hessian condition numbers, and saddle-point escape dynamics.
- [Pillar V: Dynamical Systems & Lyapunov](https://zoth.nullai.tech/docs/math/lyapunov): Phase space attractors, Hamiltonian orbits, and Lyapunov stability proofs.
- [Pillar VI: Neuromorphic STDP](https://zoth.nullai.tech/docs/math/stdp): Exponential Spike-Timing-Dependent Plasticity proofs and biomorphic synaptic weight adaptation.
